description: Surrogate primary key, generated as an identity column. Internal, not stable across releases.
Pickup location identifier, unique within the instance. Referenced by raw_data.customers.parcel_origin_id and by raw_data.travel_matrices through the shared per-instance location namespace.

Planar x coordinate in the same frame as raw_data.customers. The scale is instance-set specific and carries NO dataset-wide unit -- it is NOT meters and differs between publications. NOT a geographic coordinate. Never derive a distance from coordinates; use raw_data.travel_matrices.
Planar y coordinate in the same frame as x_coordinate. Same caveats apply.
Elevation above the frame's reference level. NULL for batches with flat topography.
Access-restricted zone containing this location. NULL means unrestricted.
Kind of pickup location. Distinguishes facility types that differ in accessibility or opening hours. Open set: further facility types may appear in later releases.
Vehicle class eligible to serve this location. 'Optional' means either vehicle may serve it.
TRUE if the truck can recharge at this location.
Earliest permitted service start, relative to the start of the planning horizon (t = 0, corresponding to 08:00). NOT a time of day. NULL if no time window applies.
Latest permitted service start, relative to the start of the planning horizon. NULL if no time window applies.
Instance this location belongs to. ON DELETE CASCADE. This table is empty for batches whose problem variant has no pickup requests.
